title: Finite coefficients for continuous matrix representations of compact groups
statement: Let $\ell$ be a prime, let $\mathbf Q_\ell$ be the field of $\ell$-adic numbers [def-weil-l-adic-numbers], and let $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ be an algebraic closure [def-weil-algebraic-closure] with the topology of the extended $\ell$-adic absolute value. Let $G$ be a compact topological group (a group with a topology for which multiplication and inverse are continuous, such that every open covering has a finite subcover). Let $I$ be a finite set, possibly empty, and let $M_I(\Omega)$ be the multiplicative monoid of square matrices [def-weil-matrix], with $(AB)_{ij}=\sum_{k\in I}A_{ik}B_{kj}$ and identity $(\delta_{ij})$. Let $\phi:G\to M_I(\Omega)$ be a monoid homomorphism, and assume that $g\mapsto\phi(g)_{ij}$ is continuous for every $i,j\in I$. Then there is an intermediate field $\mathbf Q_\ell\subseteq E\subseteq\Omega$, finite-dimensional over $\mathbf Q_\ell$, such that $\phi(g)_{ij}\in E$ for all $g\in G$ and $i,j\in I$.
